recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If runtime IG Publisher or validator behavior needs re-verification, that follow-up belongs in the current external tooling repository; no FHIR core source change is indicated.
issue_request: FHIR-17275 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core CodeSystem issue asking that the FHIR IG publication tooling report an error when a CodeSystem definition repeats the same Concept.code; the recorded resolution was to check this condition.
initial_application: Historical git commit a06e73eadfbf7ebc7c4bc51e679c40e43eb93a2a explicitly referenced GF#17275 / svn revision 14846 and added CodeSystemValidator duplicate-code checking plus Publisher wiring to process CodeSystem resources. The Java tooling paths from that commit are no longer present in the current core checkout.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps CodeSystem active in the current build. source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml defines csd-1 as an error invariant requiring all codes in a CodeSystem definition to be unique, and CodeSystem.concept.code is conditioned by csd-1. Later Jira issues FHIR-16750 and FHIR-18600 left csd-1 in place, while FHIR-37450 treated duplicate CodeSystem codes as a csd-1 violation. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found for FHIR-17275.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core specification already carries the duplicate-code rule in build-scoped source, and the historical IG Publisher implementation code is outside this current checkout.
